demo-prinz-eugen.name: Prinz Eugen, 1941 exterior interpretation
demo-prinz-eugen.axes: right-handed: X bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse
demo-prinz-eugen.accuracy: Source-informed original exterior reconstruction. Primary recognition drawings establish dimensions and major arrangement. Body sections, minor fittings and individual small wartime changes are inferred and are not a surveyed engineering reconstruction. No interiors or exact battle damage are modeled. Neutral paint replaces specific temporary camouflage. Source drawings are period intelligence reconstructions; draft and body sections are inferred, and no claim is made to exact May24 small-AA equipment. Boat decks, aft deckhouse tiers and open-rear secondary gun shields follow the cited silhouette; their small dimensions and detailed fittings remain inferred.
